Area `behavior` is owned by WP8-BEHAV; its contracts live in `src/contracts/areas/behavior.ts`.

## `trace_api` — Trace API

Trace what the program touches using predefined typed Win32/NT API profiles: file, registry, network, process, module_load, memory_protection. Decodes paths, keys, endpoints, command lines, statuses and byte counts into one recording whose summary lists behavior per profile (query_events view summary). Install before resume_process to see startup. Observation only; BEA/Frida's own threads are filtered out.

| `session_id`     | string `^[0-9a-f]{8}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{12}$`                          | yes      | —        | Session id from spawn_process, attach_process or emu_open.                           |
| `profiles`       | array<"file" \| "registry" \| "network" \| "process" \| "module_load" \| "memory_protection"> ≤6 | yes      | —        | Profiles to trace: file, registry, network, process, module_load, memory_protection. |
| `include_failed` | boolean                                                                                          | no       | `true`   | Record failed calls too (probes such as STATUS_OBJECT_NAME_NOT_FOUND matter).        |
